name: shopify-store-products-scraper
title: Shopify Product Scraper: Catalog & Prices
description: Extract public Shopify catalog rows from authorized storefronts, including titles, brands, prices, MRP, product types, stock status, images, and URLs. Includes a safe official Mock.Shop demo.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

product-scraped.eventDescription: Charged for each Shopify product extracted and saved to the dataset.
